description: NaAlCl₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic P2_12_12₁ space group. Na¹⁺ is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven Cl¹⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Na-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.78-3.35 Å. Al³⁺ is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four Cl¹⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Al-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.14-2.16 Å. There are four inequivalent Cl¹⁻ sites. In the first Cl¹⁻ site, Cl¹⁻ is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na¹⁺ and one Al³⁺ atom. In the second Cl¹⁻ site, Cl¹⁻ is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na¹⁺ and one Al³⁺ atom. In the third Cl¹⁻ site, Cl¹⁻ is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na¹⁺ and one Al³⁺ atom. In the fourth Cl¹⁻ site, Cl¹⁻ is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na¹⁺ and one Al³⁺ atom.
